messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not use Amoxicillin if you are allergic to amoxicillin.
Do not use Amoxicillin if you are allergic to any other penicillin antibiotic.
Examples of other penicillin antibiotics include ampicillin, dicloxacillin, oxacillin, and penicillin.
Other penicillin antibiotics include brands such as Omnipen, Principen, Dycill, Dynapen, Bactocill, Beepen-VK, Ledercillin VK, Pen-V, Pen-Vee K, Pfizerpen, V-Cillin K, and Veetids.
Before using amoxicillin, tell your doctor if you are allergic to cephalosporins.
Examples of cephalosporins include Omnicef, Cefzil, Ceftin, and Keflex.
There are other cephalosporins as well.
Also, tell your doctor if you have asthma.
Tell your doctor if you have liver disease.
Tell your doctor if you have kidney disease.
Tell your doctor if you have a bleeding or blood-clotting disorder.
Tell your doctor if you have mononucleosis (also called "mono").
Tell your doctor if you have any type of allergy.
Amoxicillin can make birth control pills less effective.
Triplet: ["cephalosporin", "includes", "Omnicef"]

The relation 'includes' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug class or category includes the specific drug or entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has controlled substance schedule': The subject drug is classified under the controlled substance schedule specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
